title: Even quotient component is degreewise bijective
statement: For a commutative ring A, a bicomplex K of A-modules with zero positive columns, short complexes S_a and isomorphisms e_a from their middle complexes to column -a, assume every S_a is short exact. For every natural j and integer k, the explicit map evenQuotientComponent of [lem-pc-derived-total-filtration-even-quotient-map] from (S_j).X₁ in degree k+j to degree k of the cokernel of F_(2j) → F_(2j+1) is bijective.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09KP, alternating column filtration; second reading of the Lean proof

mathlib_searches.query: quotient of direct sum by the sum of all other summands is isomorphic to one summand
mathlib_searches.results: DirectSum.IsInternal projection formulas and ModuleCat.coprodIsoDirectSum; no theorem for these filtration submodules. Submodule.quotientEquivDirectSum requires finite rank and a principal ideal domain, absent here.
General cokernel maps and universal properties, not this explicit filtration quotient.
No msearch hits. Local search of homology modules found filtration quotient users and the odd quotient, but no prior even component identification.

lean.statement:
theorem evenQuotientComponent_bijective
    (h_exact : ∀ j, (S j).ShortExact) (j : ℕ) (k : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective (evenQuotientComponent K S e h_positive j k)

proof.text: Pair the existing injectivity and surjectivity theorems for the explicit even quotient component. Injectivity is still open; surjectivity is now proved without new holes.
